clauses.label: sole paragraph
clauses.text:
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution of the United  
States of America, and in order to increase the membership of the Presidential  
Commission on Drunk Driving by two, it is hereby ordered that the second  
sentence of Section 1 of Executive Order No. 12358 of April 14, 1982, is  
amended to read as follows: “The Commission shall be composed of no more  
than 28 members appointed by the President.”.

versions.research_rationale:
Identity: the registered original is the Federal Register printing of Executive Order 12376 (47 FR 34349, Federal Register of August 9, 1982; govinfo PDF text layer, grade original_representation_unverified, recorded as acceptable as original), headed Presidential Commission on Drunk Driving and signed August 5, 1982. It increases the membership ceiling of the Presidential Commission on Drunk Driving. Inventory: one amending sentence, confirmed against the full held text. Ending: Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12376, whose subject line describes increasing membership on the Presidential Commission on Drunk Driving. The order has no sunset of its own. The parent Commission's own termination date is a disclosed earlier candidate and not the first end: Executive Order 12415 of April 5, 1983 (48 FR 15117) amended section 4(b) of Executive Order No. 12358, as amended, to provide that the Commission shall terminate on December 31, 1983, and no held instrument extends it, so the Commission, and with it the membership ceiling this order set, had no operation after December 31, 1983 (functionally spent on that date on the inclusive reading). That instrument does not name Executive Order 12376, so under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on unnamed instruments it is not an end; this order remained on the books until Executive Order 12553 revoked it by number.  The packet’s number-citation lookup over the held order texts (33,118 readable files) found no held text citing this order by number other than its own printings. Searches: the OFR executive-order catalog search and the USC and eCFR citation searches were selected after reading their coverage notes (complete; no coverage warning; the USC edition runs through 2026-10-09 and the eCFR search to 2026-10-14, which cannot matter for an order whose end is shown in 1986 or earlier).
